question: What role is the deity asked to assume when worshipped with supreme devotion?
premises: The deity is worshipped with supreme devotion.
The worshipper addresses the deity directly.
The deity is asked to give happiness.
inference: The tenth mantra asks the supremely worshipped deity to become the giver of happiness.
plain_english: Worshipped with supreme devotion, may you become the giver of happiness to me. (10)
